title: Mo Dao Zu Shi (Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation)
author: Mo Xiang Tong Xiu

title: The Two Towers
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
description: The Fellowship is broken, but the quest to destroy the One Ring continues across the war-torn lands of Middle-earth. While Frodo and Sam press on toward Mordor with the creature Gollum as their guide, Aragorn, Legolas, and Gimli join the fight to defend Rohan against the rising might of Saruman.

title: The Return of the King
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
description: The final volume of Tolkien's epic masterpiece follows the culmination of the War of the Ring. As Aragorn takes up his royal mantle, Frodo and Sam approach Mount Doom to destroy the One Ring once and for all.

title: Srimad Bhagavatam
author: Vyasadeva
description: Srimad Bhagavatam, also known as the Bhagavata Purana, is a revered Hindu sacred text that narrates the stories and teachings of Lord Krishna and his various avatars. It explores profound philosophical concepts, devotional service (bhakti), and the cosmic history of the universe through captivating dialogues and narratives.

title: Between the Water and the Woods
author: Simone Snaith
description: When her little brother breaks their village's strict taboos, Emeline must use her family's forbidden magic to save him from hungry forest shadows. To warn the dying king of the rising threat, she embarks on a perilous journey to the capital under the protection of a cynical magister and a formidable knight.

title: California Diaries #14: Amalia, Diary Three
author: Ann M. Martin
description: In the fourteenth installment of the California Diaries series, Amalia continues her personal journal entries, navigating the complexities of teenage life, friendships, and growing up in California. This intimate diary offers a heartfelt look into her thoughts, struggles, and daily experiences during a pivotal time in her youth.
